tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tab bar, sheets. All text tokens pass AA on it.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, pressed cards, tooltips, chips, rest-timer pill.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal scrim under celebrations and sheets (pair with 20px blur).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only (1.5:1, never the only boundary of a control).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, unselected chips. 3.4:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headlines, numbers, body. 16.2:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels and supporting text. 8.3:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Captions, axis labels, placeholders. 5.1:1 on bg-surface, 4.6:1 on bg-raised.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on any accent-filled button or chip (7.0–13.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-weight
tokens.usage: Weight pillar: trend line, journey bar, pace. 6.4:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: accent-weight-deep
tokens.usage: End stop of the weight gradient (rings, trend glow). Not for text.

tokens.name: accent-food
tokens.usage: Nutrition pillar: calorie ring, Log buttons, completed sets. 12.5:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: accent-food-deep
tokens.usage: End stop of the food gradient. Not for text.

tokens.name: accent-train
tokens.usage: Training pillar: workout ring, Start workout. 6.5:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: accent-train-deep
tokens.usage: End stop of the training gradient. Not for text.

tokens.name: accent-steps
tokens.usage: Steps pillar: step ring, day chart area. 9.9:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: accent-steps-deep
tokens.usage: End stop of the steps gradient. Not for text.

tokens.name: accent-reward
tokens.usage: Streaks, achievements, PRs only. 11.0:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: accent-reward-deep
tokens.usage: End stop of the reward gradient (flame, badge rays). Not for text.

tokens.name: macro-protein
tokens.usage: Protein bar and labels. 7.5:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: macro-carbs
tokens.usage: Carbs bar and labels. 12.9:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: macro-fat
tokens.usage: Fat bar and labels. 9.4:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: status-ahead
tokens.usage: Pace AHEAD. Always paired with ▲ icon and the word.

tokens.name: status-on-pace
tokens.usage: Pace ON PACE. Always paired with ● icon and the word.

tokens.name: status-behind
tokens.usage: Pace BEHIND, over-target, at-risk. Amber, never red. 10.1:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only. Never for food or weight states. 5.7:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: ring-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of every progress ring and bar.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal dashed chart gridlines.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: 62 g protein to go — 3 hours left

styles.name: label-m
styles.usage: Buttons, chips. Uppercase only for status chips.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, ring label gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Major section breaks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Top inset on full-screen modals.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, PR chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inputs, set-row cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheet tops, celebration panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, rest-timer pill, tab indicator.

shadow.note: Dark UI: no drop shadows on cards. Glow is reserved for progress (rings, trend line, active states).

tokens.name: glow-weight
tokens.usage: Trend line, journey knob, pace hero.

tokens.name: glow-food
tokens.usage: Calorie ring, completed ring pulse.

tokens.name: glow-train
tokens.usage: Workout ring, Start workout button.

tokens.name: glow-steps
tokens.usage: Step ring.

tokens.name: glow-reward
tokens.usage: Badges, streak flame, PR flash.

tokens.name: highlight-top
tokens.usage: 1px top highlight that separates cards from the background.

duration.note: Motion timing (springs live in the README: damping/stiffness can't be tokens).

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Chips, toggles, fades, tab cross-fade.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Sheet content, card enter.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Ring fill on mount, chart draw-in.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Onboarding reveal, hero count-up, badge flip.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for data reveals and number tweens.

tokens.name: ease-decelerate
tokens.usage: Elements entering.

tokens.name: ease-accelerate
tokens.usage: Elements exiting.
